Assets → Import Workbench metadata → Select project and sidecars opens two native file pickers: choose addon.gproj, then up to 500 .meta files inside that project. The worker reads supported identities only. Review resource paths, GUIDs, empty/missing target warnings and dependency gaps; use the warning filter and pages. Export resource index saves the reviewed metadata. Use reviewed resource index makes it available in unit property review and invalidates any older property review. Neither action edits the mission or spawns game entities. Cancellation or rejected files retain the previous metadata review. Clear metadata review affects this panel only; clear the property source index separately if needed. Restart clears session metadata. Native loading, component configurations and server availability remain unverified. Expand a prefab row, choose Planning asset name and Planning asset type, then Prepare unit asset. In Units, Apply changes or Place new unit saves its GUID and provenance with that unit. Preparing alone does not edit the mission; unassigned catalog entries last only for this session. Review project identity only chooses just addon.gproj and lists its addon identity and declared dependency gaps, with zero prefab resources. GameProject Configurations blocks are accepted as opaque text. Download manifests cannot supply prefab GUIDs; use verified metadata sidecars for asset assignment. Load resource index JSON opens one native JSON picker for an exported Companion resource index, including multiple addons. Imported observations are declarations; referenced files and native availability are not checked. Review owner IDs and declared dependency gaps, then prepare GUID-qualified prefab assets normally. Cancelled or invalid indexes retain the previous review.
